entries.title: Named Buildx builder is absent
entries.root_cause: The workflow selects the forge-arm builder without creating it on the fresh runner. Create that builder before selecting it.

entries.title: Named Buildx builder is absent on another run
entries.root_cause: The workflow selects the forge-arm builder without creating it on the fresh runner. Create that builder before selecting it.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request runs on a different runner and fails while inspecting the same selected builder after a cache restore.

entries.title: Registry denies base image pull
entries.root_cause: The registry account lacks pull access to the private alloy-base repository. Grant that account read access to the repository.

entries.title: Registry denies image push
entries.root_cause: The registry token has only pull scope, so it cannot push to the foundry-output repository. Issue a token with push scope for that repository.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e3, the registry rejects an image operation with an authorization error, but this push is blocked by token scope rather than repository membership.
